pkgmetadata.longdescription:
MLIR-AIE (IRON) is AMD/Xilinx's MLIR-based dataflow compiler for the AI Engine array found in Ryzen AI / XDNA NPUs, together with the IRON Python API ("import aie") used to author and build NPU compute kernels. It emits designs for the AIE array and lowers them through the Peano (dev-util/llvm-aie) backend; XRT (dev-util/xrt) plus the amdxdna kernel driver provide on-device execution.
This ebuild repackages the upstream prebuilt, CPython-ABI-specific wheel matching the selected PYTHON_SINGLE_TARGET. The version is pinned in lockstep with the exact Peano build it is CI-tested against.
